title: senecio erucifolius subsp. lycopifolius
intro: Senecio erucifolius subsp. lycopifolius, commonly known as Groundsel, is a plant species within the daisy family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Groundsel include its ability to modulate the immune system and its potential to act as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its anti-aging effects. Groundsel contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
